Pura Girinatha Utama mandala (jero) Inner Courtyard | The holiest and the most sacred zone within the pura.
Pura Girinatha Madya mandala (jaba tengah) Courtyard: the middle zone of the temple, where the activity of adherents takes place, and also the location for supporting facilities of the temple.
Pura Girinatha Nista mandala (jaba pisan): the outer zone, which directly connects the pura compound with the outer realm, and the entrance to the temple.
